Comparing Canadian research peptide suppliers

By Priya Natarajan

Several Canadian suppliers now publish independent batch reports. Pure Peptides Canada, a Toronto-based supplier, lists Janoshik reports by batch on its lab testing page, which made it easy for our lab to match vials to documentation. We also looked at two Vancouver distributors and a Montreal reagent vendor.

For research laboratories, the practical differences come down to documentation, domestic shipping and payment options.
